note: Feature catalogue for the Ender 3 S1 configurator. Every define listed exists in configs/Ender3S1-F1-v2/ and is flipped by tools/configurator/apply_features.py. Costs are the price of having the feature ON; they are estimates until the first calibrated build says otherwise, and the UI shows predicted vs measured.

machines.label: Ender 3 S1 / S1 Pro board v2.4.S1.301 (STM32F103RCT6)
machines.bootloader_note: 28 KiB SD bootloader at 0x08000000; application at 0x08007000

machines.label: Ender 3 S1 with an STM32F401 board
machines.reason: F401 boards take a different image with a different vector offset and a 64 KiB bootloader on some variants. This builder only emits F103 images; flashing an F103 image onto an F401 board produces a silent board.

machines.label: Ender 3 V2 / other mriscoc printers
machines.reason: Different pin map, different display and different bed geometry. Not covered by this catalogue.

baseline.label: Ender3S1-F1-v2 (shipped build, 2026-07-30)
baseline.stamp_offset_note: the configurator stamps the image with Ender3S1-CFG, whose identity strings are 32 bytes shorter than the shipped Ender3S1-F1-v2 strings; measured by building the default selection
baseline.running_note: the image on the printer right now (Ender3S1-F1-v2-20260730.bin) uses 232344 bytes of flash; the configurator stamps a shorter identity string, so the same feature set builds to 232312. The UI compares against 232344 so the delta is honest about the real machine.
baseline.add_margin_note: Marginal costs are measured one feature at a time. Stacking twelve of the off-by-default features overflowed the link by 452 bytes with 152 bytes of predicted headroom - about 38 bytes per added feature of composition error. 64 bytes per added feature is carried as a margin so the planner and the greedy preset stay on the safe side; the result panel always reports the exact measured size.

features.label: Adaptive Step Smoothing
features.summary: Blends step timing across segments; costs RAM, not much flash.

features.label: Advanced Pause Feature
features.summary: M600 filament change with parking, retract and reload.
features.build_failed: required by FILAMENT_RUNOUT_SCRIPT, which uses M600: it cannot be removed on its own

features.label: Arc Support
features.summary: G2/G3 arc moves. The slicer's arc welder needs this; turning it off is the single biggest flash saving available in the motion stack.

features.label: Babystep Display Total
features.summary: Shows total babysteps since the last home.

features.label: Babystepping
features.summary: Live Z nudging from the panel (includes M290).

features.label: Bezier Curve Support
features.summary: G5 bezier moves, for hosts or scripts that emit them.

features.label: Fan kickstart (100 ms)
features.summary: Boosts the part fan briefly so it spins up reliably at low duty cycles.

features.label: Filament Load Unload Gcodes
features.summary: M701/M702 load and unload macros.

features.label: Fwretract
features.summary: Firmware retraction (G10/G11). Redundant with slicer retraction, but harmless.

features.label: Input shaping on Z
features.summary: Third shaper axis. Compiled in the shipped build but switched off at runtime with M593 Z F0, so it currently costs flash and does nothing.

features.label: Input Shaping X
features.summary: Shaping on X. X and Y are separate defines but share one shaper implementation.

features.label: Input Shaping Y
features.summary: Shaping on Y.

features.label: Linear advance
features.summary: Pressure advance (M900). Measured at K0.08 on this machine; the screen's LA tuning item requires it.

features.label: Live Z from the host (M293/M294)
features.summary: Babystepping through the emergency parser, so OctoPrint can nudge Z mid-print.

features.label: Non-linear extrusion (M592)
features.summary: Flow correction for back-pressure under-extrusion. Inert until A/B/C are calibrated with M592.

features.label: Nozzle clean (G12)
features.summary: Automated nozzle wipe pattern. Only useful if your start G-code calls G12.

features.label: Nozzle Park Feature
features.summary: G27 parks the head away from the print.
features.build_failed: required by ADVANCED_PAUSE_FEATURE, which is enabled: it cannot be removed on its own

features.label: Skew correction (M852)
features.summary: Compensates a non-square frame. Identity factors until you measure them, so it changes nothing today.

features.label: Slowdown
features.summary: Lowers acceleration near the axes' endstops.

features.label: Smooth linear advance
features.summary: Ramps pressure instead of stepping it (M900 U). Removes classic linear advance's acceleration ceiling.

features.label: Bed Tramming Include Center
features.summary: Adds a centre point to the tramming wizard.

features.label: Enable Leveling after G28
features.summary: Turns bed leveling back on automatically after G28.
features.conflict_note: Marlin refuses both: 'Only enable RESTORE_LEVELING_AFTER_G28 or ENABLE_LEVELING_AFTER_G28, but not both.'

features.label: Extrapolate Beyond Grid
features.summary: Extrapolates the mesh past its outermost probed points.

features.label: High-speed probe mode
features.summary: Faster probe deployment. Probing dominates bed-mesh time, so this is worth keeping unless it misbehaves.

features.label: Multiple probing per point (2 + 1 extra)
features.summary: Two fast probes and one slow re-probe, averaged. Turn this off and EXTRA_PROBING must stay 1 or the ProUI build sanity check aborts, so the two defines are always flipped together.

features.label: Preheat before Leveling
features.summary: Heats the bed before probing so thermal expansion is measured, not guessed.

features.label: Probe Offset Wizard
features.summary: On-screen wizard for setting the Z probe offset.

features.label: Restore Leveling after G28
features.summary: Restores the mesh state after every G28 instead of leaving it off.
features.conflict_note: Marlin refuses both: 'Only enable RESTORE_LEVELING_AFTER_G28 or ENABLE_LEVELING_AFTER_G28, but not both.'

features.label: Z Min Probe Repeatability Test
features.summary: M48 probe repeatability test.

features.label: Fan Soft Pwm
features.summary: Software PWM for the part fan. [unsupported here]
features.build_failed: required by this board: disabling it fails the sanity check ('FAN_SOFT_PWM is required for your board')

features.label: Hotend Idle Timeout
features.summary: Switches heaters off after a period of inactivity.

features.label: MPC Autotune
features.summary: M306 autotune - the command that produced this machine's MPC coefficients.

features.label: MPC autotune menu
features.summary: Runs M306 autotune from the screen. Only needed while tuning the hotend model.

features.label: MPC PTC
features.summary: Models the PTC heat cartridge's resistance change with temperature.

features.label: Pidtempbed
features.summary: Bed PID instead of bang-bang. Off means bang-bang, which is cheaper in flash and rougher on the bed.

features.label: 5 G-code macros in EEPROM
features.summary: M810 to M819, persisted. Useful for per-filament settings sets (temperature, linear advance, input shaping).

features.label: Advanced Ok
features.summary: Sends buffer occupancy with every ok so a host can keep the queue full.

features.label: Auto Report Position
features.summary: Pushes position reports to the host automatically.

features.label: Auto Report SD Status
features.summary: Pushes SD card status to the host on a timer.

features.label: Auto Report Temperatures
features.summary: Pushes temperature reports to the host.

features.label: Cable flashing (binary file transfer)
features.summary: M28 B1 upload plus reboot-to-install, so firmware can go over USB instead of the SD card dance. Pulls in the heatshrink decoder. Dropping it is the single biggest saving available.

features.label: Emergency Parser
features.summary: M108/M112/M410 are acted on mid-move. Turning this off removes the emergency stop.

features.label: Host Action Commands
features.summary: Marlin sends action commands (pause, prompt) to a capable host.

features.label: Host Prompt Support
features.summary: Host can display and answer Marlin prompts.

features.label: Host status notifications
features.summary: Marlin pushes state changes to the host as action notifications.

features.label: Long Filename Host Support
features.summary: Host can see long SD filenames instead of 8.3 names.

features.label: Sdcard Sort Alpha
features.summary: Sorts the SD file list. Costs a few kilobytes of RAM, not flash.

features.label: Activate Mesh Item
features.summary: Menu entry to temporarily enable mesh leveling.

features.label: Advk Tune Item
features.summary: Linear advance K tuning straight from the screen. Needs linear advance compiled; removing LA removes this item too.

features.label: Ccloud Print Support
features.summary: Creality Cloud print support. [does not compile on this tree]
features.build_failed: does not compile on this tree: the cloud path needs print-stats globals that are configured out here

features.label: Jd Tune Item
features.summary: Junction deviation tuning straight from the screen.

features.label: Mediasort Menu Item
features.summary: Menu entry to toggle SD file sorting.

features.label: No Blink Ind
features.summary: Stops the dashboard icon from blinking.
features.measurement_note: measured -64 B, i.e. no measurable cost: the difference is inside the linker's section alignment

features.label: Preview Menu Item
features.summary: Menu entry to toggle the SD thumbnail preview.

features.label: Screen: custom colour themes
features.summary: Colour picker and its menu. Pure cosmetics.

features.label: Screen: endstop diagnostics
features.summary: Endstop state page in the menu.

features.label: Screen: G-code preview
features.summary: Parses thumbnails and preview data from the SD file. Heaviest of the screen extras.

features.label: Screen: live temperature plot
features.summary: Graph of temperature over time on the screen.

features.label: Screen: lock screen
features.summary: Scroll-to-unlock cover so a stray touch does not start a print.

features.label: Screen: toolbar
features.summary: Configurable toolbar on the status screen.

features.label: Smooth Encoder Menuitems
features.summary: Smoother value changes when turning the encoder.

features.label: Zoffset Save Settings
features.summary: Saves settings immediately after a Z offset change from the menu.

features.label: Config Export
features.summary: M503-style configuration export over the host link.

features.label: Eeprom Auto Init
features.summary: Writes defaults automatically when the EEPROM version does not match.
features.measurement_note: measured -64 B, i.e. no measurable cost: the difference is inside the linker's section alignment

features.label: EEPROM chatter
features.summary: Echoes a confirmation for every settings command. It was trimmed out of the shipped build to buy flash for the feature set, so this is the catalogue's one add-back toggle.
features.measurement_note: enabling it against the default selection overflowed FLASH by 300 bytes with 1160 free, so the real cost is 1460 bytes, not the 130 first guessed

features.label: Eeprom Init Now
features.summary: Resets EEPROM on first boot - the opposite of keeping calibration across a flash.

features.label: M503 settings dump
features.summary: The full settings echo. It is the only way to inspect everything at once, but it costs about 2.7 KB and it is also the command that watchdog-resets this build.

features.label: Power-loss recovery
features.summary: Resumes an interrupted job. Needs the SD card left in the printer: the recovery file lives on it.
features.note: the screen's PLR tune item is enabled in the shipped build and depends on this define, so turning PLR off turns the menu item off with it - SanityCheck enforces the pair

features.label: Print statistics (M78)
features.summary: Counts prints, finished jobs, total time and filament used.

features.label: Sdcard Readonly
features.summary: Read-only SD card support. Claimed to save about 2 KB, but it removes the ability to write print job data. [conflicts with cable flashing]
features.build_failed: conflicts with POWER_LOSS_RECOVERY ('Either disable SDCARD_READONLY or disable POWER_LOSS_RECOVERY'); it would also need binary file transfer off

features.label: Speaker
features.summary: Screen buzzer. Needs the panel to actually have one.

calibration.method: every feature built twice-baselined: features on in the shipped image were measured by turning them off against it, features off by turning them on against a slimmed baseline (shipped minus the UI extras, BFT, macros). Signed deltas, so a feature that saves flash prices negative.

screen.note: The panel runs a compiled .zlib that cannot be built here - its source is not public, and its menus are drawn from the mainboard's ProUI defines, which the mainboard catalogue already controls. What can be chosen is the OS image and the asset pack, and they must match the mainboard firmware family. Choosing a mismatched pack is how this panel was bricked in July.
